applicability: Invariant and family selection when reopening a closed leaf from its own recorded comparison.
conditions: For a dataset generation of an unconverted repository, the retained knowledge snapshots are readable and contain the selected recorded subject.
The read resolves the generation-specific guarantee and exact member revision identities.
A tree comparison is resolved from the tree ids the leaf recorded.
exclusions: Missing or corrupt retained channels remain explicit failures; another dataset cannot satisfy this obligation.
A historical review does not establish that its authored knowledge was delivered to the published line.
statement: A recorded comparison keeps the knowledge operand it was frozen on: a leaf that recorded a tree comparison is reopened from its recorded tree ids, and a leaf of an unconverted repository reopened from its own dataset generation still answers a selected invariant or family with that family's authored guarantee and its exact member revisions rather than refusing for want of a dataset. Once the repository's official memory line is converted, a leaf that recorded only a dataset comparison keeps its code sides and states its knowledge sides as legacy-unavailable; no database is read for it.
